title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theatre on 1972-10-18

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1972 show highlighted by a smoking Playin’ > Dark Star > Dew > Playin' suite, with good overall recording despite some hiss and mix quirks.
ai_review.review: The performance is consistently praised as powerful and “smoking,” especially the seamless Playin’ → Dark Star → Dew → Playin’ sequence that many reviewers call a highlight of the night. The soundboard source delivers clear audio; listeners note a slight hiss in the second set and occasional mix imbalance between Bob and Keith, but overall the recording is considered very good. Individual players receive kudos – Phil’s bass solo, Bob’s distinctive “bite” tone, and Keith’s audible keyboards round out an unforgettable show.

ai_rating.rationale: All seven reviews are overwhelmingly positive about the music; most give 5‑star ratings, and the few technical criticisms (hiss, mix balance) are minor, leading to a strong combined show/recording score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Minor hiss in the second set; occasional prominence of Bob's guitar over Keith's keyboards, but overall clear and well‑balanced soundboard recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transitions, especially the unique and powerful Playin' → Dark Star → Dew → Playin' sequence; energy builds throughout both sets.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass solo praised as sweet, telepathic interplay, with notable thematic references during the solo.
band_member_comments.Bob: Guitar tone described as having an extra "bite" of distortion that adds character; often prominent in the mix.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's keyboards are audible and good, though sometimes the mix favors Bob over Keith.
